critique: The orange-on-black palette, dense lower source, and strong t1-to-t4 upward travel clearly communicate rising embers. At t1 the field is a reasonably coherent vertical cluster, but at t4 it still blooms too widely at the top and is cropped by the frame edge, reading more like an upward explosive burst than a sustained tapered ember plume. Individual particles remain large, uniformly circular glowing dots rather than sharper, varied hot embers.

suggestions.why: Reduce the excessive upward travel so the plume remains contained and coherent at t4 instead of expanding and cropping at the top edge.
Narrow directional spread to preserve a tapered rising column with moderate drift rather than a broad explosive spray.
Sharpen particle edges so the particles read more like hot embers and less like soft circular bokeh.
